statements.status_notes: CVE-2026-103111 (GHSA-r9hj-j2rw-4q3m): in PCRE2 10.48 and earlier, a regular expression that is JIT-compiled and matched with a growable JIT stack (pcre2_jit_stack_create() and pcre2_jit_stack_assign()) can write outside the stack area. Interpreter and DFA matching, and JIT matching on the default machine stack, are not affected. Upstream fixed it in PCRE2 10.49 with commit 2b40382 (https://github.com/PCRE2Project/pcre2/security/advisories/GHSA-r9hj-j2rw-4q3m, https://github.com/PCRE2Project/pcre2/commit/2b4038298072684b0fae29b15bedfb1a75bda46d). Alpine lists the fix under pcre2 10.49-r0 in the 3.23-stable APKBUILD secfixes (https://github.com/alpinelinux/aports/blob/3.23-stable/main/pcre2/APKBUILD). The pcre2 builds published for Alpine 3.23 are 10.47-r0, 10.48-r0 and 10.49-r0; the libpcre2-8 library in 10.48-r0 reports PCRE2 10.48 and in 10.49-r0 reports PCRE2 10.49 on both x86_64 and aarch64, so 10.49-r0 is the first fixed build.

Upstream fixed it in PCRE2 10.49 with commit 2b40382 (https://github.com/PCRE2Project/pcre2/security/advisories/GHSA-r9hj-j2rw-4q3m, https://github.com/PCRE2Project/pcre2/commit/2b4038298072684b0fae29b15bedfb1a75bda46d). Debian fixed it for trixie in 10.46-1~deb13u3 (DSA-6530-1, https://security-tracker.debian.org/tracker/CVE-2026-103111). The DHI rebuild of 10.46-1~deb13u3 is the first published Debian 13 pcre2 build with the fix: its shipped changelog includes the 10.46-1~deb13u3 entry 'GHSA-r9hj-j2rw-4q3m: Fix large JIT stack allocation (Closes: #1149217)', while the earlier published rebuilds of 10.46-1~deb13u1 and 10.46-1~deb13u2 predate it and sort below it.
